skill_short_description: End-to-end read quality control and trimming pipeline. Optional preflight gate (sub-skill: preflight/sequali-input-preflight) validates raw reads (file presence, md5 if provided, paired-end parity, platform detection) before QC raw reads (sequali + multiqc), identify issues, trim/clean (fastp/fastplong/trim_galore), then QC trimmed reads to verify. Sandwich pattern: Preflight → QC → Trim → QC → Go/No-Go.
